post.title: BFS — Breadth-First Search: Level-by-Level Graph Exploration
post.subtitle: BFS explores graphs level by level using a queue — the key to shortest paths and level-order problems.
post.brief: BFS explores a graph level by level using a FIFO queue, guaranteeing the shortest path in unweighted graphs. Recognize BFS problems by keywords: "shortest path," "minimum steps," or "level order." Time: O(V + E). Space: O(V). Mark nodes visited on enqueue — never on dequeue.
